whyItMatters: PHP shell functions pass strings to an OS shell, where metacharacters in attacker-influenced input become command injection.
actions: Replace shell calls with native PHP APIs (filesystem functions, process handling with argument arrays).
If a shell call is unavoidable, wrap every dynamic fragment in escapeshellarg() and never interpolate input.
Re-run a SAST scan and confirm DPK-SAST-006 is no longer observed.
verification: The finding disappears on rescan and dynamic values never reach a shell unescaped.

example.caveat: Escaping is a backstop, not a design: prefer scandir() and friends over listing through a shell.
